card.name: The letter D starting Dose or Daily
card.fires_on: The capital D that starts "Dose", "Daily" or "Dosage" when it is split off after a heading word such as Usual, Recommended, Maximum or Total. It is mostly in all-caps or title-case dosing table headings.

modes.description: The D opens "DAILY" in all-caps headings like usual or total daily dose.
